caption:
Software is shifting from tools humans operate to autonomous capabilities that execute workflows directly.

In a recent update, OpenAI detailed how AI-native startups like Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs turn core operational processes—including onboarding, account management, and developer integrations—into agentic capabilities.

Instead of static software with manual steps, these architectures use AI agents to navigate edge cases dynamically.

What internal workflow in your business do you think will turn agentic first?
